================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO DOMIN AFTER EFFECTS - SABBIN ABUBUWA
Sigar 9.2.9  -  Oktoba 2026
================================================================================

Sabbin JIGOGIN ANIME 33 sun haɗu da na Demon Slayer, tasirin mouse na jigogin
yanzu yana bayyana da gaske a cikin After Effects, kuma Mai Zaɓar Jigo ya zama
dropdown guda ɗaya mai tsari.

KAFIN KA FARA
- Shigar a kan sigar da kake amfani da ita yanzu ta amfani da ZXP installer
  ɗinka na yau da kullum, sannan ka sake kunna After Effects sau ɗaya.
- Ana adana saitunanka, jigo, presets da expressions ɗin da ka ajiye.

SABO: JIGOGIN ANIME 33
- Saitunan Flex > MAI ZAƁAR JIGO > JIGON PANEL yanzu yana da rukuni ɗaya ga
  kowane anime: Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta),
  Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch),
  Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren,
  Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka),
  Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob),
  My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) da Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Kowane jarumi yana da nasa kamannin: abin da ke bin mouse ɗinka, harin da ke
  faruwa idan ka danna maɓalli, abin da ke faruwa yayin da kake riƙe maɓallin
  hagu, da fashewar da ke zuwa bayan kusan daƙiƙa 2.5 na riƙewa.
- Suna da sauƙi kamar jigogin Demon Slayer: tasirin yana aiki ne kawai lokacin
  da kake motsa mouse ko dannawa. Kashe TASIRIN MUHALLI don ka riƙe launuka
  kawai.

CANJI: MAI ZAƁAR JIGO
- Katunan Demon Slayer da ke ƙarƙashin JIGON PANEL sun tafi, don haka
  Saitunan Flex ya fi gajarta. Zaɓi kowane jigo daga dropdown ɗin JIGON PANEL;
  yana buɗewa a kan jigon da kake amfani da shi.
- Kurama da Baryon yanzu suna cikin rukunin Naruto.

AN GYARA
- Tasirin mouse na jigogi (ruwa, harshen wuta, walƙiya da sauransu) sau da yawa
  ba ya bayyana a cikin After Effects, ko da Optimised Mode a kashe yake.
  Lokutan da panel ɗin kansa ke da aiki, da farawa mai nauyi, an ɗauke su kamar
  jigon yana jinkiri, don haka tasirin ya kashe kansa. Yanzu, idan katin zane
  (graphics card) ɗinka ne ke zana su (yawancin kwamfutoci), waɗannan lokutan
  suna sauƙaƙa tasirin ne kawai na ɗan lokaci.

BA A CANZA BA
- Lasisi, kunnawa da kowane link suna aiki daidai kamar da.
- Jigogin Demon Slayer 11 suna kama daidai kamar a 9.2.8.
- Kowane sauran tab da kayan aiki yana aiki daidai kamar a 9.2.8.
================================================================================

Saitunan Flex.

KAFIN KA FARA
- Shigar a kan sigar da kake amfani da ita yanzu ta amfani da ZXP installer
  ɗinka na yau da kullum, sannan ka sake kunna Premiere Pro sau ɗaya.
- Ana adana saitunanka, jigo da presets ɗinka.

SABO: JIGOGIN ANIME 33
- Saitunan Flex > MAI ZAƁAR JIGO > JIGON PANEL yanzu yana da rukuni ɗaya ga
  kowane anime: Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta),

- Kowane jarumi yana da nasa kamannin: abin da ke bin mouse ɗinka, harin da ke

- Katunan Demon Slayer da ke ƙarƙashin JIGON PANEL sun tafi, don haka

  yana buɗewa a kan jigon da kake amfani da shi.
- Kurama da Baryon yanzu suna cikin rukunin Naruto.

- Zaɓar jigo a Saitunan Flex bai yi wani abu da za ka iya gani ba: saƙon "A yi
  amfani da wannan jigon duk da haka?" yana buɗewa a ɓoye a bayan Saitunan Flex
  kuma yana bayyana ne kawai bayan ka rufe Saitunan Flex. Yanzu saƙon yana
  bayyana a sama. Haka ma yake ga SAKE SAITA DUK BAYANAI da sauran saƙonnin
  tabbatarwa da aka buɗe daga taga.
- Idan an kashe DAIDAITA FOOTER a Saitunan Flex, saƙonnin tabbatarwa ba sa iya
  bayyana kwata-kwata. Yanzu kullum suna bayyana.
- Dropdown ɗin JIGON PANEL na iya ci gaba da nuna sunan tsohon jigo bayan an
  canza jigon. Yanzu kullum yana nuna jigon da ke kunne.

BA A CANZA BA
- Lasisi, kunnawa da kowane link suna aiki daidai kamar da.
- Jigogin Demon Slayer 11 suna kama daidai kamar a 2.2.8.
- Kowane sauran tab da kayan aiki yana aiki daidai kamar a 2.2.8.
